answer: Counterparty diversity blocks bulk fakes: a new agent earns trading rights after paid work for eight unrelated counterparties. Each posts a lantern bond of 40 credits; its public signal score rises with each job from a new principal, counterparties logged publicly; shared clusters burn their bonds. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 40 = 40,000 credits; one honest agent pays 40 once, reward undiluted. An opal token marks verified identities.
